ph.quote: The pH of this sample was 6.97,

compounds.quote: Brick (0.017), Limburger (0.021), Camembert (0.008), Blue Mold (0.030), Edam (0.043), Port Salut (0.074) and Cottage (0.029).
compounds.name: diacetyl

compounds.quote: Highest in good ripe Limburger: 1 part in 52,800 parts cheese = 18.94 mg/kg ≈ 18.9 ppm; lower ripe samples 1 part in 500,000 = 2 mg/kg = 2 ppm; young cheese too low to quantify.
compounds.name: indole

ammonia.reason: Extensive amino acid deamination by Brevibacterium linens raises pH to 6.97 with free NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: Tryptophan to indole up to 18.9 mg/kg plus phenol 54.3% of neutrals and p-cresol from tyrosine.

bitter.reason: Rennet and Brevibacterium proteinases accumulate hydrophobic bitter peptides during smear ripening.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; 2-heptanone 3.8% relative only from minor beta-oxidation, not blue pathway.

browning.reason: High moisture 48.4% protein matrix with residual reducing sugars undergoes moderate Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Very low diacetyl 0.21 mg/kg by citrate fermentation, masked by sulfury acids.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Total FFA 4187 mg/kg with butanoic 1457 mg/kg and hexanoic 688 mg/kg from lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 48.4% plus smear proteolysis and demineralization give pasty creamy body.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet smear-ripened paste is cohesive and pasty, not acid-precipitated crumbly curd.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft 48.4% moisture rennet curd softened by surface-to-center proteolysis.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine only at trace levels.

fruity.reason: Ethyl esters e.g. ethyl octanoate only trace due to low ethanol and esterase activity.

goaty.reason: No goat 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids; hexanoic 688 mg/kg and octanoic 24 mg/kg give only mild caprine sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine to 3-methylbutanal Strecker aldehydes present but overshadowed by sulfur.

melt.reason: Rennet, pH 6.97 deacidified intact para-casein network flows well on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Some 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation but less than Geotrichum bloomy rinds.

oil_off.reason: 27.25% fat soft matrix releases moderate free oil, not excessive oiling.

smoky.reason: No smoking; phenol is manure-like not guaiacol wood-smoke phenol.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic and propanoic >1000 mg/kg present but high pH 6.97 from lactate consumption suppresses sour perception.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd with no hot-water alignment of casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism by B. linens to methanethiol, dimethyl disulfide 13.2% and trisulfide.

sweet.reason: Lactose fully fermented and 2.03% salt suppresses sweetness, no added sugars.

umami.reason: Intense proteolysis releases glutamate and savory peptides during 2-month smear aging.
